call_points.text: Top line guided to mid-teens growth; MD said he would like to review it higher to high teens
FY27 EBITDA margin to stay broadly in line with FY26
Backward integration expected to add ~300 bps margin by FY28 and 100 bps more by FY29
Supply-chain disruption cost ₹24 Cr in Q1; management expects pressure only up to Q2
ABD Maestro FY26 top line was ~₹40 Cr and management expects it to double in FY27
Rangapur malt distillery expected operational in H1 FY27; PET plant already EBITDA accretive
ENA needs for the next four years planned to be met from captive sources
~₹400 Cr overdue from Telangana; old dues partly cleared, new supplies paid on time
Analyst pressed on ABD Maestro revenue; management called it too small and gave no figure
Exports footprint widened to 39 countries in Q1FY27 from 36 in Q4FY26
FY27 consolidated revenue growth guided at mid-teens, with P&A at high teens by FY28.
FY28 EBITDA margin guidance raised to 18% from 17%.
Malt distillery in Telangana expected operational in H1FY27; ENA distillery expansion in Maharashtra in H1FY28.
Phase 1 and 2 integration to add ~300 bps to EBITDA margin by FY28 and ~100 bps more by FY29.
Only ~30 bps of FY26 gross margin gain came from the PET plant; the rest from price rises and trade-spend control.
ESOP charge of ₹5-6 Cr per quarter in FY27, not applicable last year.
West Asia war expected to pressure margins in Q1 and early Q2; management assumes resolution in a month or two.
Karnataka excise policy not yet implemented; management says it could be neutral to positive for Officer's Choice.
Telangana dues: FY24 and FY25 fully cleared, balance to be cleared soon.

Alleged non-payment of GST on outward supply of ENA 2. Alleged non-payment of GST on outward supply of DDGS and DWGS 3. Alleged irregular availment of ITC on invoices issued by suppliers whose registration stood cancelled retrospectively 4. Alleged non-payment of GST under RCM on label / brand registration fees paid to the Government 5. Alleged non-payment of GST under RCM on amounts paid to Government for services received. The Company has filed a detailed response to the Show Cause Notice before the jurisdictional authority. The matter is currently pending adjudication, and the next date of personal hearing is awaited.

operating_notes.text: Income-tax orders for Assessment Years 2014-2015 to 2024-25, dated 6-22 April 2026, gave effect to CIT(A) orders and left net nil tax liability.
Andhra Pradesh revived the LOI for a greenfield IMFL bottling plant of about 46.5 lakh cases a year, valid up to 26-09-2028, subject to a DM2 (MGO) licence and payment of dues.
Recommended final dividend of ₹5.40 per share for FY26.
P&A volume salience 47.0% and value salience 57.7% in Q4FY26, against 42.4% and 51.6% in Q4FY25.
ICONiQ White reached 10.7 mn cases in FY26, up 87.8% from 5.7 mn cases in FY25.
International presence widened to 36 countries in FY26 from 23 in FY25; ICONiQ White launched in 9 countries.
Alok Gupta stepped down as Managing Director and KMP effective May 31, 2026, and Amar Sinha was appointed as Managing Director effective June 1, 2026.
Approved incorporation of wholly owned subsidiary ABD UK Ltd in the United Kingdom with initial capital of 100 GBP.
FY26 P&A contributed 47.2% of volume and 57.3% of value; ICONiQ White sold 10.7 million cases.
Export revenue grew 14.1% to ₹235 Cr in FY26, with footprint expanding from 23 to 36 countries.
PET bottling plant in Telangana commissioned in Q2FY26 and EBITDA accretive from Q3; covers 70-75% of requirement.

June 7, 2026: Mr. Balaji Shivdas Pawar, partner of subsidiary Minakshi Agro Industries LLP, filed a ₹25.5 Cr Statement of Claim before Sole Arbitrator Smt. Sadhana Jadhav under a Deed of Retirement cum Admission dated 10 December 2024, with
Prestige & Above contributed 48.2% of volumes and 59.3% of value in Q1FY27, against 46.2% and 55.8% in Q1FY26.
ICONiQ White did 3.1 million cases in Q1FY27 (+33.8% YoY) and is targeted at close to 15 million cases in FY27 from 10.7 million in FY26.
ABD Maestro had ~₹40 Cr top line in FY26, is available in 6 international markets and 4 travel retail locations, with over 5,500 premium touch points.
Commenced commercial operations at Moradabad bottling facility with ~6 million cases per annum capacity.
Commenced commercial operations at ~4.4 million BL per annum greenfield malt distillery at Rangapur, Telangana.
Directorate of Revenue Intelligence visited Mumbai office and Aurangabad facility regarding industry-wide HSN review for bulk Scotch imports with no financial impact.

timeline.summary: Allied Blenders' subsidiary ABD Dwellings had its ₹16.16 Cr income-tax liability reduced to zero following an appellate order.
Allied Blenders received income-tax orders for Assessment Years 2014-2015 to 2024-25 giving effect to CIT(A) orders, resulting in net nil tax liability.
ABD Maestro won three Gold medals at the London Spirits Competition 2026 for ZOYA and WOODBURNS brands.

Andhra Pradesh's Principal Secretary, Revenue (Excise.I) revived Allied Blenders' Letter of Intent up to 26-09-2028 for a greenfield 46.5 lakh-case IMFL bottling plant, subject to a DM2 (MGO) licence and payment of dues.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,908.77 Cr (-1.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹40.97 Cr (-47.9% YoY).

FY26 results (consolidated): income from operations ₹3,949 Cr (+11.5%), EBITDA ₹568 Cr (+25.8%), PAT ₹220 Cr (+13.0%); Q4 PAT ₹38 Cr (-52.1%) after a ₹45.45 Cr prior-year tax charge; dividend of ₹5.4 per share recommended.
Mr. Alok Gupta stepped down as Managing Director, and Mr. Amar Sinha was appointed as Managing Director effective June 1, 2026.
May 21, 2026: Allied Blenders and Distillers approved the incorporation of an overseas wholly owned subsidiary in the UK named ABD UK Ltd with 100 GBP initial capital.

May 15, 2026: On the Q4FY26 earnings call, Allied Blenders guided FY27 consolidated revenue growth at mid-teens and FY27 EBITDA margin to hold FY26's 14.4%, and raised its FY28 EBITDA margin target to 18% from 17%.

June 7, 2026: Allied Blenders disclosed a ₹25.5 Cr arbitration claim filed by Mr. Balaji Shivdas Pawar, partner of subsidiary Minakshi Agro Industries LLP, over a December 2024 retirement deed; the company will contest it and file a counter-claim.
On its 24 July 2026 Q1FY27 call, ABD reported revenue of ₹984 Cr (+5.8% YoY) and PAT of ₹45 Cr, with a ₹24 Cr supply-chain hit, and guided to mid-teens FY27 sales growth.
Allied Blenders and Distillers commenced commercial operations at its Moradabad bottling facility with ~6 million cases per annum capacity on October 19, 2026.
Allied Blenders commenced commercial operations at its ~4.4 mn BL per annum greenfield malt distillery at Rangapur, Telangana.

On 21 October 2026, DRI officials visited Allied Blenders and Distillers' Mumbai office and Aurangabad facility for an industry-wide review on bulk Scotch HSN code applicability with no financial impact.
